hard_release_gate.description: Representative-build median aggregate DPS ratio 1.7x–2.3x independently for level 1→6 and level 6→11.

slices.title: Bootstrap: Control plane
slices.scope: Durable control plane only: PLAN.md, epic-state.json, schema, epic:status CLI, tests, handoff. No equipment gameplay changes.
slices.notes: Claimed by Producer session 7b4a2e77. Status advances to 'validated' when this PR merges; Producer fills commit_evidence with the merge SHA.

slices.title: DPS ratio measurement tooling
slices.scope: Deterministic script that computes representative-build aggregate DPS at levels 1, 6, and 11 for Floor 2; outputs the two ratio values consumed by the hard release gate.

slices.title: Tier 1 equipment catalog
slices.scope: New EquipmentItemDef entries for Floor 2 levels 1–5 (one weapon tier + supporting armor/accessory slots) targeting a ~1.7–2.3× DPS contribution over the unequipped level-1 baseline.

slices.title: Tier 2 equipment catalog
slices.scope: New EquipmentItemDef entries for Floor 2 levels 6–11 (one weapon tier + supporting armor/accessory slots) targeting a ~1.7–2.3× DPS contribution over the Tier 1 equipped level-6 baseline.

slices.title: Shop / loot-table wiring
slices.scope: Wire Tier 1 items into early Floor 2 shop archetypes and chest loot tables; wire Tier 2 items into mid/late Floor 2 archetypes and loot tables.

slices.title: DPS ratio validation sweep
slices.scope: Run headless AI sweeps (≥30 seeds) measuring the median aggregate DPS ratio at both checkpoints; adjust item tuning if either ratio falls outside 1.7–2.3×.

slices.title: CI gate (deterministic DPS ratio test)
slices.scope: Add a deterministic unit test that statically verifies the representative-build DPS ratio for both checkpoints, enforcing the 1.7–2.3× hard gate in CI.
